'''Cam Solusar Not So Quiet Mining Colony v2.0''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Cam Solusar]]
* '''Published:''' 30 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Quiet Mining Colony
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 QMC Solusar LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

<Strategy>

Basically the same strategy, but different cards.
I added a copy of Millennium Falcon and several interrupts like Punch It!, Rapid Fire, and Direct Assault. I added Sense and Alter as well and swapped some characters. This deck offers lots of retrieval and power in space, with mostly evasion on the ground and some beatdown with Obi-Wan. Thoughts?


Re Revelation's comments: I took your advice and changed it.
